scheme_name: Asangathit Karmakar Samachar-Patr Hawker Cycle Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be an unorganized newspaper delivery worker (hawker) registered in any district of Chhattisgarh.
Workers receiving benefits from any parallel scheme are not eligible.
benefits_summary: A free cycle will be provided to each eligible unorganized newspaper delivery worker.
